CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: The _____ was Hardware cache of a central processing unit.
CPU cache.fact: A CPU cache is a hardware cache used by the central processing unit (CPU) of a computer to reduce the average cost (time or energy) to access data from the main memory.

CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: Cache memory is typically implemented with static random-access memory (_____), which requires multiple transistors to store a single bit
CPU cache.fact: Cache memory is typically implemented with static random-access memory (SRAM), which requires multiple transistors to store a single bit. Some modern designs implement some or all of their cache using the physically smaller eDRAM, which is slower to use than SRAM but allows larger amounts of cache for any given amount of chip area.

CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: Some modern designs implement some or all of their cache using the physically smaller eDRAM, which is slower to use than _____ but allows larger amounts of cache for any given amount of chip area
CPU cache.fact: Cache memory is typically implemented with static random-access memory (SRAM), which requires multiple transistors to store a single bit. CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: The memory device with that value, normally implemented in _____, holds that value in a very low-energy form that is not powerful enough to be read directly by the CPU
CPU cache.fact: The memory device with that value, normally implemented in DRAM, holds that value in a very low-energy form that is not powerful enough to be read directly by the CPU. By locating the memory physically closer to the CPU the time needed for the buses to settle is reduced, and by replacing the DRAM with SRAM, which hold the value in a form that does not require amplification to be read, the delay within the memory itself is eliminated.

CPU cache.subject: Computer & IT
CPU cache.question: A single TLB can be provided for access to both instructions and data, or a separate _____ TLB (ITLB) and data TLB (DTLB) can be provided
CPU cache.fact: Many modern desktop, server, and industrial CPUs have at least three independent levels of caches (L1, L2 and L3) and different types of caches: Translation lookaside buffer (TLB) Used to speed up virtual-to-physical address translation for both executable instructions and data. A single TLB can be provided for access to both instructions and data, or a separate Instruction TLB (ITLB) and data TLB (DTLB) can be provided.
